claims: Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU) is a public research university in Richmond, Virginia.
Virginia Commonwealth University was founded in 1838.
Virginia Commonwealth University serves over 29,000 students.
VCU Rams basketball team competes in the Atlantic 10 Conference.
VCU was established in 1838 as Hampden-Sydney medical department.
VCU offers over 200 degree and certificate programs across 17 colleges and schools.
VCU is top 50 in national research expenditures according to the National Science Foundation.
VCU had over $500 million in sponsored research in 2024.
Virginia Commonwealth University Rams compete in Division I.
Virginia Commonwealth University Rams compete in the A-10 Conference.
VCU Rams had a 2011 Final Four run.
VCU Health includes schools of medicine, dentistry, nursing, and pharmacy.
VCU urban campus is integrated into downtown Richmond.
2026 VCU men's basketball team qualified for the NCAA tournament.
2026 VCU men's basketball team achieved a first-round upset of North Carolina.
